programmes.d: An eccentric transient and his motley offspring bring tragedy to a peace-loving rancher and his family.
A lonely widow takes angry revenge after realizing she has mistaken half-breed Quint Asper's kindness for romantic interest. (TV-PG)
A doctor-turned-ballad-singer is hunted down by the husband of a girl he failed to aid.
Matt suspects a new arrival of being a ruthless criminal.
Festus Haggen, left in charge of Marshal Dillon's office, soon gets into trouble with two hunters.
A powerful Indian leader encounters the hostility of Dodge City residents while en route to the White House to discuss peace terms.
When an old Indian scout murders a man, Matt pursues him into Comanche territory.
The son of a killer seems set on proving that he is worse than his badman lather until he meets a convent-bred girl.
The feud between ranchers Noah Haimes and Clete Bolden is rekindled by the romance of Haimes's only son and Bolden's only daughter.
Festus tries to go into the freight business and it nearly results in matrimony.
Seeking refuge from a storm, Festus Hagen stumbles into a cave where an old Indian lies dying.
Sam Groom and Sandra Morgan play a fugitive and his Indian wife who frustrate Newly by seeking medical help for their baby and then refusing to take his advice
An ex-lawman and old friend of Matt's arrives in Dodge with failing eyesight, and a man who wants to kill him.
Doc Adams takes up arms to defend a gold shipment from bandits, first during a stagecoach ambush and then at a way station.
A released convict comes to claim as his own a married woman who for years had been corresponding with him purely out of kindness.
Kitty's father arrives in Dodge to try and take her back to New Orleans.
A 17-year-old girl attempts to alleviate the impoverished condition of herself and her 12-year-old brother by finding a husband.
After eight years in prison for robbery, a farmer returns home and hopes to find the stolen fortune he had buried under a tree.
A former sheriff plans his revenge on Matt for firing him.
A seriously wounded old-time outlaw is brought to Dodge City where he tries to find his long-neglected daughter before he dies.
A saloon girl does not want her ex-fiancé to know about her job.
A corrupt group attempts to take over Dodge City's law enforcement when Marshal Dillon is thought to be dead.
A beautiful Indian maid seeks refuge with Festus Haggen after running away from the man who bought her from her father.

An egotistical drifter swears to get revenge on a wealthy rancher who beat him badly in poker.
Matt Dillon, bushwhacked, will either die or become paralyzed unless a bullet is removed from an area near his spine.
Festus and Newly overpower outlaws transferring stolen gold from a train to a wagon and head off with the wagon and the gold.
Doc Adams faces a critical decision as to whether he should personally operate on the gravely wounded Marshal Dillon.
